title: The Case of the Leaky Rowboat
story: Someone pulled the drain plug on the boatyard's work rowboat, one of the last boats still in the water, and it sank gently into two feet of water at the slip. Felix is fuming, politely. The plug turned up at the bottom of a bailing bucket left on the dock, and five people were at the slips that afternoon, each hauling a different boat out for the winter. Who pulled the plug?

texts: Nico arrived earlier than the canoe's owner.
Kenji arrived at either 1:15 p.m. or 1:45 p.m.
Of Nico and Hal, one brought the anchor and the other brought the net.
Hal arrived later than the person with the bucket.
Of Priya and Hal, one brought the oars and the other brought the net.
The person with the net arrived at either 1:00 p.m. or 1:45 p.m.
The person who arrived at 2:00 p.m. hauled out neither the canoe nor the dory.
The person with the cooler arrived later than the skiff's owner.
The dory's owner arrived at neither 1:30 p.m. nor 1:45 p.m.
The canoe's owner arrived exactly 30 minutes after the punt's owner.
The person with the oars did not arrive at 1:30 p.m.
